headline: Senate passes aviation mental health measures as college sports bill heads toward final vote Monday!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate passed two aviation-related bills: the John A. Hauser Mental Health in Aviation Act and the Aviation Medication Transparency Act, both addressing FAA regulations for pilots and air traffic control specialists. The chamber also passed the Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe Project Lands Restoration Act and voted down a war powers resolution on Iran, 49-50.

onTheFloor.title: Protect College Sports Act - revises name, image, and likeness rules for student athletes and intercollegiate competition
onTheFloor.status: Post-cloture debate scheduled Monday 4-5:30 PM; vote expected 5:30 PM

onTheFloor.title: John A. Hauser Mental Health in Aviation Act - updates FAA regulations for pilots and air traffic controllers with mental health disclosures
Aviation Medication Transparency Act - requires FAA to publish list of approved medications for airmen and air traffic control specialists
Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe Project Lands Restoration Act - takes federal land in Washington into trust for the tribe
War Powers Resolution measure on Iran hostilities - directs President to remove U.S. forces from conflict

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly in pro forma session for less than four minutes, conducting no substantive legislative business. The chamber received messages from the Senate and held three bills at the desk.

onTheFloor.title: Veterans Health Administration - requires sterile processing technicians to hold professional certification
Veteran Education - prohibits educational institutions from withholding transcripts for Post-9/11 GI Bill users
Student Privacy Protection - requires prior written consent for personal information surveys in schools
